$comment: Boot-payload budget (#485 D), enforced by `node scripts/check-build-manifest.mjs --budget` in the 'Build without Emscripten' CI job and mirrored into vite.config.ts build.chunkSizeWarningLimit. Sizes are raw (un-gzipped) bytes of build/assets/*.js; 1 kB = 1000 bytes like Vite's reporter. Raise a number only with a reason in the PR; lower it whenever a phase earns the room.
entryNote: Ceiling = the entry after the follow-up split (698,257 B) rounded up to the next kB. Raised 699,000 -> 707,000 B (CI unbreak, Phase A): #508 (InputHub + KeyboardMouseSource, the ghost codec v4 input track) merged into the split's branch and put the entry at 707,769 B with every main run red; ScriptedSource (?input=script only) moved behind a dynamic import (-1.4 kB) and the rest is the hub every vehicle reads each frame, so it stays on the boot path: 706,350 B, rounded up. Raised 707,000 -> 709,000 B (#502, C ABI / worker-wire hardening): the main-thread wasm loader is on the boot path and gained the one-retry + fetch abort, the heap-exhausted error the bound allocateGrid throws, the HUD trap / heap rows and the cached segment sampler (+2.3 kB: 708,673 B); the trap parser itself was split out (wasmTrap chunk, loaded only for ?wasmTrapTest=1). The 700 kB target is missed by ~6 kB again. What left the entry, raw: Rapier glue + @react-three/rapier -> vendor-rapier (167 kB, statically imported so it is modulepreloaded and counted in bootJs); GLTFLoader (44 kB, first model preload), SSAOPass (12 kB, preset High) and SMAAPass (61 kB, aa tier smaa) behind composerPassModules, KTX2Loader + zstddec (60 kB, only fetched on a GPU with a compressed target); RaftVehicle (23 kB), WgslSweSim (22 kB, native WebGPU only); PauseMenu / SettingsPanel / RunResultsPanel and the physics / wireframe / SWE-bed overlays; LevelLoader and ReachManager + ReachStreamer + ReactiveAudio (?level= and ?reach= only); fauna, biome props and set pieces as one `extras` chunk (42 kB, preloaded at idle). Per-biome loading was NOT done per biome: the biome-exclusive decorations are ~38 kB pre-minify in total, so they share the chunk with the fauna instead of adding one request per biome. The bundled map JSON (~43 kB) is still in the entry: maps/registry.ts is read synchronously by MapSystem, routing, the StartMenu and the persistence layer. Raised 709,000 -> 722,000 B (#486 B-D, gamepad / touch / comfort): main was already at 711,846 B once the duplicate RunResultsPanel import in GameHUD (a bad merge that stops the bundle building at all) is removed, +2.8 kB over this ceiling; this PR adds 9.3 kB to that (721,170 B). It would have been ~19 kB: GamepadSource + gamepad mapping (4.3 kB), the haptics envelopes (1.5 kB), the menu-focus engine (3.6 kB), the debug hotkeys (0.9 kB) and the handheld envelope (1.3 kB) are all dynamic imports now (gamepadconnected / first menu / ?debug=1 / touch device), as are the touch layer and source. What stays in the entry is the part every player runs: the settings store v2 (+2.4 kB, 11 comfort / haptics / gamepad / touch fields + the v1 -> v2 migration), the comfort resolver and its live cache (+1.1 kB), the PAUSE bus and edge, the look-apply component, InputHubTick's pad loader, and the thin lazy facades. Raised 722,000 -> 734,000 B (#464 A-F, the living river): main is at 711,860 B; this adds 21.4 kB (733,214 B). New modules, raw: the WeatherDirector + weather script + its tick and reach fraction (4.5 kB), the sky clock + NOAA sun position + map atmosphere + its tick (3.1 kB), the erosion integrator + plane codec + live field (~4.5 kB), the squall front (0.9 kB), the xoshiro PRNG + FNV hash (1.1 kB), the SWE checksum (0.3 kB); the rest is growth in modules already there (router lateral/weather plumbing, run conditions, the water-sheet lookup, sweHost's clock). All of it runs every frame of every run, so it rides the boot path like the hub. Kept off it: Today's River card + generator (StartMenu, lazy), the replay plan loader (?replay= only), ScriptedSource. Raised 734,000 -> 738,000 B (raft + player rivers, phases A/C/F): main is at 733,327 B; this adds 4.1 kB (737,421 B). In the entry, because every run reads it: the vehicle water datum the raft's floating check and OOB share with the force bridge, the raft envelope, the StartMenu vehicle picker and its map-scoped choice, and the user-river session (getRunMap / the run key / ghost fairness resolve through it). Kept off it: the .wsriver import + saved-river list (UserRiverPanel, lazy, with the level validator) and the editor's ?river= hand-off loader. Lowered 738,000 -> 736,000 B (#503 E/F, layering + tests on top of the #512 code-health pass): main 737,421 -> 735,907 B — the window boundary events and RunnerVehicle/utils went, the rest are moves that do not change the entry. Raised 736,000 -> 737,000 B (#518 B, gameplay on sim time): main 735,907 -> 736,956 B (+1.0 kB). The biome cross-fade's sim-time clock (advanceBiomeTransition) and memoised provider, the ChunkManager debounce counted in update(dt) plus the spawn-biome report, the SWE readiness state the scripted harness waits on, and src/utils/wallClock.ts. All of it runs on every frame of every run, so it stays on the boot path. Raised 737,000 -> 741,000 B (#521 A, SimCore): main 736,100 -> 740,019 B (+3.9 kB). New on the boot path, all of it runs every frame of every run: SimCore itself (fixed-step accumulator, ordered registry, SimContext and its run stream), SimCoreTick (the −90 sample of camera / vehicle / hub frame into the context), and the system adapters that were already in the entry as frame callbacks and are now registry entries (weather, sky, chunk biome, survival, pillar clocks, score + ghost clock) plus their composition list. Nothing left the entry in exchange: the callbacks they replace were bodies inside components that stay. Rounded up to the next kB.
totalJsNote: All-chunks ceiling: a growth guard, no longer a target. Issue #485 asked for <= 3.5 MB; getting there needs ~53 kB of code removed, not moved, and each lazy split adds a few kB of overhead (validators +3.2 kB; this split +10 kB: 3,542,049 -> 3,552,565 B). The metric that matters for a player is bootJsMaxBytes above, so the 3.5 MB target is retired in its favour (the second option in the follow-up issue's acceptance). Ceiling = today's number rounded up. History: #487 Phase A 3,518,645 B (+2.6 kB, terrain tile mirror); #487 Phase B 3,542,049 B (+23.4 kB, mesh builders + light pool + the sim worker's copy); CI unbreak Phase A 3,562,432 B (+9.9 kB, #508's input hub and ghost codec v4); #502 3,568,437 B (+6 kB: the entry's +2.3 kB, the same loader hardening again in the sim worker chunk, and the 1.4 kB lazy wasmTrap chunk). #464 A-F 3,622,945 B (+21.4 kB entry growth, see entryNote, and the lazy Today's River / replay chunks). Raft + player rivers 3,632,133 B (main was already 3,623,058 B, 58 B over this ceiling; +9.1 kB: the entry's 4.1 kB and the lazy UserRiverPanel / userRiverImport chunk). #503 E/F 3,632,065 B (-68 B; the ceiling stays at its rounded 3,633,000). #518 3,633,023 B (+1.0 kB, the entry's sim-time growth); ceiling rounded up to 3,634,000. #466 follow-up (render-chain correctness: mirror reflection, TSL fallback pin, one shadow update) 3,636,067 B (+3.0 kB of real code: the planar-mirror math, the session backend pin, the composer's shadow-once scene pass); the reflection pass moved behind a lazy chunk (WaterReflection, 3.1 kB, High/Ultra only), so the entry went down (736,956 -> 736,849 B) and only the total grew; ceiling rounded up to 3,637,000. #521 A 3,637,635 B (the entry's +3.9 kB, see entryNote); ceiling rounded up to 3,638,000. #521 C1 (App split into boot/ ui/ harness/) 3,637,078 -> 3,638,382 B (+1.3 kB): the hook / component boundaries cost ~1.3 kB of property names and prop reads, paid for in the entry by moving the dev-only overlays (DebugPanel + SWE bed + F/G hotkeys + "Show debug", one DevOverlays chunk) and the ?replay= / ?river= autostart (autostartRun chunk) behind their flags, so the entry went down (739,613 -> 739,207 B) and only the total grew; ceiling rounded up to 3,639,000.
bootJsNote: Boot JS = the entry plus every chunk index.html modulepreloads (Vite's static-import closure of the entry): entry 698,257 + vendor-three 1,119,187 + vendor-rapier 167,144 = 1,984,588 B, rounded up to the next kB. Raised 1,985,000 -> 1,993,000 B (CI unbreak, Phase A) for #508's input hub, same reason as entryNote: entry 706,350 + vendor-three 1,119,187 + vendor-rapier 167,144 = 1,992,681 B. Raised 1,993,000 -> 1,996,000 B (#502) for the same +2.3 kB of entry: 1,995,004 B. It was ~2,295 kB (a 1,174.7 kB entry + a 1,120.3 kB vendor-three) before the split, so the boot closure fell by ~310 kB raw, not just moved: GLTFLoader, SMAA/SSAO, the raft, the WGSL stepper, the Reach path, the overlays and the extras are outside it. KTX2Loader and (on medium/high) SMAAPass are still fetched during a typical boot, but as lazy chunks that no static import waits on. The GLSL boot never fetches three.webgpu or the node stack. Raised 1,996,000 -> 2,008,000 B (#486 B-D) for the entry's +9.0 kB over a main that was itself 2.2 kB over: 721,170 + 1,119,187 + 167,144 = 2,007,501 B. Raised 2,008,000 -> 2,020,000 B (#464 A-F) for the entry's +21.4 kB over main (see entryNote): 733,214 + 1,119,187 + 167,144 = 2,019,545 B, rounded up. Raised 2,020,000 -> 2,024,000 B (raft + player rivers) for the entry's +4.1 kB: 737,421 + 1,119,187 + 167,144 = 2,023,746 B as reported, rounded up. Lowered 2,024,000 -> 2,023,000 B (#503 E/F): 735,907 + 1,119,181 + 167,144 = 2,022,232 B, rounded up. Raised 2,023,000 -> 2,024,000 B (#518 B) for the entry's +1.0 kB (see entryNote): 736,956 + 1,119,181 + 167,144 = 2,023,281 B, rounded up. Raised 2,024,000 -> 2,027,000 B (#521 A) for the entry's +3.9 kB (see entryNote): 740,019 + 1,119,187 + 167,144 = 2,026,350 B, rounded up.
